interpretation: The Q80 lane8/shared math is not the bottleneck: kernel mean is ~0.376 ms/call and D2H/scatter are negligible. Stage dominates: 31.96 ms/call at 2GB and still 27.14 ms/call at 12GB. Increasing VRAM cache from 8GB to 12GB does not improve hit rate (~60.2% to ~60.3%) because the remaining misses are cold first-touch unique down experts, not steady eviction. fallback_reason shows gate/up CPU fallback remains the larger unresolved bucket.
decision: Do not pursue more down-only cache size/source micro-edits as a SOTA route. Down GPU correctness is available through Q80 lane8/shared, but performance needs either source prefetch/pack strategy that removes cold first-touch stage cost, or more importantly a prompt-general up/gate/down grouped GPU path. No SOTA changed.
next_step: Plan should prioritize prompt-general up/gate GPU compatibility/fusion or a general expert source pack; any down-only change must first prove it reduces stage miss cost, not just increase VRAM cache.
